generation.path: Landing site for the MEASURED STT-error lexicon, plus the one reduction T-062 itself attests. tools/train-intent/src/extract_stt_errors.py is committed and emits noisy->corrected rows carrying evidence.runRevision, evidence.occurrences, evidence.registers and evidence.rowIDs; its output is PENDING a server run, so no measured row is authored here yet. When the run lands its rows attach as entries in this file with evidence.source = corpus — no code change. The one shipped entry is the quick-speech reduction T-062 records in order to stop it being re-filed onto the dialect axis.

entries.note: T-062 basis: "NOT dialect and NOT pan-regional spelling — quick-speech reduction the STT noise pass already produces; belongs to the articulation axis (Part E), never the dialect axis. Recorded here to stop re-filing. Same class as an attached-vs-separate clitic (माइक्रोवेभ/माइक्रोवेभमा, design §5.3): a segmentation effect, not a dialect variant." — filed here as the segmentation/reduction effect T-062 says it is, NOT as orthographic drift: the two forms differ in a consonant (स / ह), so calling this a spelling variant would mis-file an articulation-axis fact onto the text axis. It carries no dialect label and applies to every speaker.
